root_text: According to WHO, the current levels of activity for viral respiratory tract infections in the northern hemisphere - including influenza, RSV, human metapneumovirus (hMPV) and mycoplasma pneumonia - are consistent with previous years.

nodes.text: According to WHO, the current levels of activity for viral respiratory tract infections in the northern hemisphere - including influenza, RSV, human metapneumovirus (hMPV) and mycoplasma pneumonia - are consistent with previous years.

nodes.author: healthytravelau
nodes.text: The WHO report also notes that there have not been any unusual outbreak patterns in China for this time of year. Furthermore, Chinese health officials report that their health system is NOT overwhelmed.

nodes.author: healthytravelau
nodes.text: It’s still important to note that respiratory tract infections remain a significant cause of traveller morbidity. Travellers should stay informed, be aware of the risks, and take steps to reduce exposure to respiratory viruses.
